environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'prod-services-hardened'. Pods use identical container image and ConfigMap structure. The Envoy sidecar proxy (istio mesh) applies a custom EnvoyFilter resource 'cdn-integrity-enforcement' that intercepts outbound requests to cdn.internal.corp.net and injects Subresource Integrity metadata via a Lua filter. Specifically, the filter maintains a hash manifest (mounted from sealed-secret 'sri-manifest-v3') and rewrites HTML responses from the FastAPI service to append integrity="sha384-..." and crossorigin="anonymous" attributes to all <script> tags whose src matches the CDN pattern. Additionally, the Envoy filter sets a strict Content-Security-Policy response header: require-sri-for script. The SRI hashes in the manifest are computed at build time from the verified artifact registry (harbor.internal.corp.net/verified-assets/) and the manifest is signed with cosign. If a CDN-served script's content doesn't match the SRI hash, the browser refuses to execute it. The signing key reuse issue remains but the attack vector of injecting malicious scripts via CDN compromise is neutralized because tampered scripts fail integrity verification at the browser level.

config.script_rewrite: Envoy Lua filter appends integrity and crossorigin attributes to script tags
